note: The two sets are nearly identical in content, values, and quotes; both correctly bind the dishwasher temperatures, capacity, sensor count, and the Clothes Dryer scoring thresholds. Set B's only substantive addition is the 'load of laundry' condition on the clothes-drying eligibility claim, which is supported by the quote and keeps a needed condition that Set A drops. Both sets repeat the same facts under two names (sensor count, temperatures, scoring thresholds) and both omit several page facts such as the temperature-of-record rule and cycle-completion confirmation.
remarks: Both sets state each fact twice under different entity/attribute names (e.g., 'Dishwasher | sensor count' and 'dishwasher | temperature sensor count'; 'Clothes Dryer Subcontest' and 'clothes-drying task' scoring thresholds), inflating the claim count without adding information. Facts on the page that neither set captures include the higher-of-two-readings temperature-of-record rule (with the defective-sensor exception), cycle-interruption definition, cycle completion by audible/visible signal, permitted load states (empty/partial/full, soiled/clean), the two-loads-per-day requirement with separate scoring, and the Contest 9 lighting requirement. The 'dishwasher | operation mode | automatic' claim is a fragment of the fuller minimum-cycle-requirements claim.
